description: Call right after showing the user the review link. Waits until the user has finished grading (or timeout_seconds passes, at most 240), then returns the same result as get_human_judgments. If it returns before the user is done, call it again or ask the user how it is going.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait, in seconds. Default 120, at most 240.

name: wait_for_human_review
title: Wait for the user to finish grading
